objections.title: AC2 timeline pattern entry\.image && !sm covers guard line L1828 only — misses on L1830, enabling partial-patch false-pass
objections.description: The updated AC2 specifies the timeline site passes when '0 matches for entry\.image && !sm without cover_image'. This pattern matches L1828 ({entry.image && !sm && showDetails && () in the unpatched state — good. However, L1830 contains the img tag: . If a developer patches ONLY the guard on L1828 to {(entry.cover_image || entry.image) && !sm && showDetails && (}, the entry\.image && !sm pattern returns 0 matches — but L1830 still renders src={entry.image} without the cover_image fallback. The AC2 recipe would declare PASS while the bug persists at the render point. The pattern must also verify the src= line.
objections.evidence: Confirmed by reading react_template.tpl L1828-1830: L1828 is guard '{entry.image && !sm && showDetails && (', L1830 is img tag ''. Pattern entry\.image && !sm matches only L1828. After patching L1828 guard only, grep returns 0 — false PASS while L1830 still has unpatched src.
objections.required_fix: AC2 timeline site: extend the 'Passes when' check to also require 0 matches for 'src={entry\.image}' in lines 1828-1835. Both the guard line and the src= line must be patched.
